title: 第一卷 第12章 暮年破境，炼气二层
novel_title: 凡人修仙：疯了吧，你百岁高龄才入门
content_zh:
灵力奔腾，周天流转。

    原本稳固圆满的炼气一层修为，在海量精纯药力冲刷下，瞬间突破桎梏。

    无形屏障轰然破碎。

    一股更强、更凝练的灵力，盘踞丹田。

    炼气二层！

    成了！

    短短一夜苦修，稳步破境！

    寻常外门弟子，从一层到二层，少则一月，多则三月。

    天赋平庸者，甚至需要半年打磨。

    而苏玄尘，仅凭一夜，直接跨越一层壁垒，踏入二层行列。

    而且根基无比扎实，灵力纯净度、凝练度，远超同阶修士。

    突破瞬间，周身气质悄然蜕变。

    原本苍老衰败的气息，消减大半。

    眉宇浑浊散去几分，多了几分仙韵沉静。

    佝偻的脊背，无形挺直些许。

    百年朽躯，正在真正意义上的脱胎换骨。

    苏玄尘缓缓收功，长长吐出一口浊气。

    气息绵长厚重，远超普通炼气二层。

    他抬手握掌，能清晰感觉到体内新生的力量。

    肉身更强，经脉更宽，灵气运转更快。

    寿元，也在这一刻，再度大幅度延续！

    “炼气二层，勉强站稳脚跟。”

    苏玄尘神色平静，并无半分骄狂。

    他起步太晚，别人少年筑基、底蕴深厚。

    他唯有步步夯实、稳中求进，才能追赶岁月差距。

    突破之后，他没有继续疯狂嗑丹升级。
content_en:
Spiritual power surges and circulates throughout the sky.

    The originally stable and complete level of Qi refining cultivation was instantly broken through by the massive amounts of pure medicinal power.

    The invisible barrier shattered.

    A stronger and more condensed spiritual power is entrenched in Dantian.

    Second level of Qi refining!

    Done!

    After just one night of hard training, he steadily broke through!

    For ordinary outer disciples, the journey from the first floor to the second floor takes as little as one month and as many as three months.

    Those with mediocre talent may even need half a year of polishing.

    And Su Xuanchen, in just one night, directly crossed the first-level barrier and stepped into the second-level ranks.

    Moreover, the foundation is extremely solid, and the purity and condensation of spiritual power far exceed that of monks of the same level.

    At the moment of breakthrough, the whole body's temperament quietly transformed.

    The original aura of oldness and decay has been reduced by most of it.

    The turbidity in the eyebrows has disappeared a bit, and there is a bit more fairy charm and serenity.

    The rickety back was invisibly straightened.

    A body that has been decayed for hundreds of years is being reborn in a true sense.

    Su Xuanchen slowly stopped his power and let out a long breath of turbid air.

    The breath is long and thick, far beyond the second level of ordinary Qi refining.

    He raised his hand to hold it, and could clearly feel the new power in his body.

    The physical body is stronger, the meridians are wider, and the spiritual energy moves faster.

    Shou Yuan also extended greatly at this moment!

    "On the second level of Qi Refining, I can barely stand firm."

    Su Xuanchen's expression was calm and not at all arrogant.

    He started too late, while others built a foundation at a young age and have a deep foundation.

    Only by making progress step by step and making steady progress can he catch up with the gap in time.

    After the breakthrough, he did not continue to crazily take pills to upgrade.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 12: Breaking through the Realm in Old Age, Second Level of Qi Refining
